planned_title: If You Can't See the Nearest Star, How Far Away Is It?
spoken: The nearest star to the Sun You can't see it. It's called Proxima Centauri, a small red dwarf. It gives out less than 1% of the Sun's light. Your two eyes are a ruler. Astronomers use the same trick with the whole of Earth's orbit. Its light still takes more than four years to reach you.

brief.frame_0: ESO Paranal time-lapse at v06 98.50 s (the 98.17 s plate, after the dissolve), 9:16 centre crop.
brief.loop_sentence: …four years to reach you. The nearest star to the Sun — you can't see it.
